change.title: npm @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 sends API version 2026-10-21 by default; MessageParam becomes a union, temperature/top_p/top_k removed, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry SDKs must move to v1 too

source.quote: * **api:** add support for new API version 2026-10-21

tasks.reasoning:
Both the MiniMax client (baseURL api.minimax.io/anthropic) and the Anthropic client are built from @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.115.0 in package-lock.json and share src/agent/loop.ts:46. The 1.0.0 major changes the default anthropic-version to 2026-10-21, turns MessageParam into a union and removes temperature/top_p/top_k. The repo does not send sampling params, document blocks or citations, so those removals do not bite. Nothing breaks while the repo stays on 0.115.0, so this is an opt-in upgrade. When doing it:
- Fix MessageParam typing in the agent loop.
- Confirm that MiniMax's Anthropic-compatible endpoint accepts anthropic-version 2026-10-21. If it does not, pin the header or apiVersion for the MiniMax client.
- Verify that the thinking, output_config, betas and context_management (compact_20260112) fields still type-check under 1.0.0.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- anthropic:2026-10-21-api-version-2026-10-21 (api-version): New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01. The repo only moves to anthropic-version 2026-10-21 by upgrading @anthropic-ai/sdk to 1.0.0, which sends that version by default. At 0.115.0 it keeps sending 2023-06-01, so the version bump is the same move.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`."
- anthropic:2026-10-14-ts-sdk-otel-default (other): TypeScript SDK 0.134.0 auto-creates OpenTelemetry spans and trace headers if a global tracer provider exists (unsure if affects; opt out with openTelemetry:false). The OpenTelemetry auto-span default only applies once the SDK passes 0.134.0, which happens in this upgrade. During the bump, check whether the app registers a global tracer provider, and pass openTelemetry:false if spans are unwanted.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "If your app registers a global tracer provider, the SDK will create spans with it after upgrading, and they'll be exported with the rest of your traces."

callSites.why: This shared beta.messages.create call is typed against SDK 0.115.0. In 1.0.0 MessageParam becomes a union and the default API version becomes 2026-10-21, so message construction and typing may need edits.

## npm @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 sends API version 2026-10-21 by default; MessageParam becomes a union, temperature/top_p/top_k removed, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry SDKs must move to v1 too [Verified]

### Change

Bumped @anthropic-ai/sdk to 1.0.0 via npm. Fixed the MessageParam union compile error in contextManager.hardTrimOldToolResults by skipping system-role messages. Pinned anthropic-version 2023-06-01 on the MiniMax client. The Anthropic client now sends 2026-10-21. Added test/provider-request.test.ts, which stubs fetch and checks headers and that no sampling params are sent. The repo has no OpenTelemetry tracer provider, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry usage, so no further changes were needed there. The thinking, output_config, betas and context_management fields type-check under 1.0.0.

Files touched:
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `src/agent/contextManager.ts`
- `src/agent/llm/provider.ts`
- `test/provider-request.test.ts`

### Why

SDK 1.0.0 makes BetaMessageParam a union (including a system role) and defaults to API version 2026-10-21, which MiniMax's compat endpoint may not accept.

> * **api:** add support for new API version 2026-10-21

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| provider-request-test | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

- provider-request-test, added by the agent: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=x MINIMAX_API_KEY=x npx tsx test/provider-request.test.ts` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npm --prefix client install --ignore-scripts` (The root postinstall (npm --prefix client install) did not run because install scripts are off, so the client subproject's dependencies (vite, react, @types/react, typescript) are missing for both typecheck and build.); it exited 0.
- Preparation changed repo files, kept out of this PR: client/package-lock.json.

Test of this change: `provider-request-test`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Whether MiniMax accepts anthropic-version 2026-10-21 is unknown; the header is pinned to 2023-06-01 for MiniMax as a precaution.
- Real behaviour of Anthropic at API version 2026-10-21 (thinking, compaction beta) was not exercised.
- Not checked: the unrelated npm audit vulnerabilities.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- Anthropic provider requests now send anthropic-version 2026-10-21.
- MiniMax requests explicitly keep anthropic-version 2023-06-01.

preparation.reasoning: The only skipped setup the checks need is the root postinstall, which installs the client folder's dependencies. Both `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` call into client via npm --prefix client. The server code needs no codegen, and env vars are only read at runtime, so none are needed.

review.summary: The diff bumps @anthropic-ai/sdk to ^1.0.0 and pins MiniMax's compat client to anthropic-version 2023-06-01. It also adds a `role === "system"` guard in hardTrimOldToolResults, presumably for the widened BetaMessageParam union. The only named call site, src/agent/loop.ts:46, never used temperature, top_p or top_k, so no request-body change was needed and typecheck passes against the v1 types. The concern is coverage: the checks prove only that the client sends the right headers on a bare `messages: [{user,'yo'}]` request against a mocked fetch. On the Anthropic path, loop.ts sends thinking, output_config, the compact-2026-01-12 beta and context_management, and it calls countTokens. None of that is exercised under the new 2026-10-21 version. Nor is how loop.ts parses responses that may now carry new block types or stop reasons. The 'verified' grade is defensible for compile-level and header-level correctness, but it overstates confidence in live behaviour.

concerns.issue: The Anthropic provider now silently sends anthropic-version 2026-10-21 with thinking:{type:'adaptive',display:'summarized'}, output_config.effort, betas:[COMPACTION_BETA] and context_management edits compact_20260112 (lines ~46-60). No check exercises this request shape under the new version. I could not confirm that these params, the compact-2026-01-12 beta, or the 'compaction' response block still behave the same in 2026-10-21; verify against the SDK 1.0.0 types and the API version notes.

The response loop handles only text, thinking, redacted_thinking, compaction and tool_use, plus the stop_reasons tool_use and refusal. If 2026-10-21 introduces new content block types or stop_reason values, they are silently dropped or treated as final. The mocked test returns a fixed old-shape response, so it cannot detect this.

countTokens is now also sent with 2026-10-21 on the Anthropic path and is untested. Failures are caught and fall back to a rough estimate, so a regression would degrade quietly rather than fail. The new `msg.role === "system"` guard is harmless (loop.ts never builds system-role messages), but it is a speculative change, not one the bump forced.

Pinning MiniMax to 2023-06-01 via defaultHeaders is a reasonable conservative choice, and the test confirms the header is overridden. However, SDK 1.x may serialize requests differently in ways MiniMax's compat layer does not expect, and nothing proves a live MiniMax call or tool_use still works. MiniMax is DEFAULT_PROVIDER, so this is the main production path.
The SDK license changes from MIT to Apache-2.0, and the SDK adds a new transitive dependency, @opentelemetry/api. This is worth a quick compliance and bundle check.

The test monkeypatches globalThis.fetch and covers only beta.messages.create with minimal params. It does not cover the thinking/compaction branch, countTokens, or streaming. The 'before fail' result reflects that this test is new and asserts the new default version; it is not evidence of a pre-existing bug that is now fixed.

checkFirst: Run one live agent turn on the 'anthropic' provider with tools and adaptive thinking under SDK 1.0.0, and confirm compaction, thinking blocks and countTokens still work with API version 2026-10-21.
Run one live tool_use round-trip on MiniMax (the default provider) to confirm the compat endpoint accepts SDK 1.x requests with the pinned 2023-06-01 header.
Check the SDK 1.0.0 type definitions and changelog for new response content block types or stop_reason values that loop.ts would silently ignore.
Confirm whether the client/ subproject imports @anthropic-ai/sdk, and whether it needs the same bump.
